sentences.en: His wealth was inherited, not a consequence of his own business acumen.
sentences.zh: 他的财富是继承来的，并非源于他自己的商业头脑。

sentences.en: She is a lady of business acumen.
sentences.zh: 她是一位具有商业头脑的女士。

sentences.en: It is obvious to me that he has no political acumen at all.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他完全没有政治头脑。

senses.zh: 不同寻常的洞察力和鉴别力：

mnemonic: 词根记忆：acu（尖，锐利）+men（表抽象名词）→敏锐
